senses.en: to steal, a sneak thief in daytime
to touch lightly and unintentionally on passing by
to speak, to say, to talk
to whittle, scrape (as a pencil with a knife)
to pick up with chopsticks or tongs
insert, place between, put under the arm, etc.
to dig up (something), to dig with a shovel
to hit, strike, with something heavy, such as a stick of wood, bamboo or hammer
